svg.title: The people in the ER with peptides are far younger than NSW GLP-1 users
svg.desc: Share by age group. ED presentations mentioning unapproved peptides, NSW, July 2025 to September 2026: 16-24 25%, 25-34 32%, 35-44 26%, 45-54 12%, 55+ 4%. Adults reporting current GLP-1 medicine use, NSW Population Health Survey 2025: 16-24 2.3%, 25-34 7.0%, 35-44 14.6%, 45-54 24.8%, 55+ 51.3%. Men: 51% of ED presentations vs 38% of GLP-1 users.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
